serverInfo.name: OpenAI-Decisions
serverInfo.title: OpenAI Decisions
serverInfo.description: Evaluate text, documents, and images with typed condition probabilities, fixed choices, and rubric scores using OpenAI Decisions.

instructions: Use Decisions for typed classifications and rubric scores, not free-form answers or field extraction. Supply inputText and/or documentUrls/imageUrls as evidence. Documents use the existing RAG/resource text extraction pipeline. Images are downloaded and sent natively as inline base64; at most 128 images are supported. SharePoint and OneDrive links use the existing authenticated downloads and require a delegated Microsoft token and consent. Predicate evaluates a condition; choice selects one of 2–255 distinct string values; score evaluates ordered labels with indices starting at zero. Optional description arrays must align with the values/labels arrays. For batches, boolean/mixed-type choices, or complex official definitions, use questions_url with a JSON file containing a single object with a nonempty questions array. Only that array is imported; the file's input, model, and other settings are ignored. Independent questions share the supplied evidence and preserve order. Use separate requests when a question depends on an earlier answer. The entire raw response, including refusal answers, probabilities, confidence, model, and usage, is returned as structured content. Calibrate thresholds for your application; probability/confidence are not guarantees. The current default model is gpt-6-luna.
